hook: Your superconductor can hang in mid-air.
title: A Disc That Hangs in Mid-Air Over a Magnet
description:
Cool a superconductor and it can float above a magnet and lock in place. This is called quantum locking, and the disc can even hang upside down. It works because magnetic field lines get pinned inside the superconductor.

#Shorts #Physics #Technology

scenes.narration: Your superconductor can hang in mid-air.
scenes.headline: HANGING IN MID-AIR

scenes.narration: Cool it down, and put it near a magnet.
scenes.headline: COOL IT, ADD MAGNET

scenes.narration: It floats, and then it locks in place.
scenes.headline: FLOATS, THEN LOCKS

scenes.narration: Push it, tilt it, even flip it upside down.
scenes.headline: EVEN UPSIDE DOWN

scenes.narration: It stays exactly where you left it.
scenes.headline: STAYS WHERE YOU PUT IT

scenes.narration: Magnetic field lines get pinned inside it.
scenes.headline: FIELD LINES PINNED

scenes.narration: A disc frozen in mid-air, no strings.
scenes.headline: NO STRINGS

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: money made of giant stone.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW: STONE MONEY
